title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E07 — MK-Ultra Revealed
The CIA's MK-Ultra program sought to create mind control methods through unethical human experimentation, and now, experts investigate classified documents that reveal the horrific atrocities that were carried out in the pursuit of national security.

title: Expedition X
description:
S09 E02 — Beast of Boggy Creek
The team heads to Arkansas, where a swamp monster has terrorized the small, rural town of Fouke for over a century.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E02 — Trapped in the Asylum
Josh, Heather and Phil continue their investigation into a haunted lunatic asylum; they encounter extreme paranormal activity, capturing stunning evidence that convinces them this is their most terrifying expedition yet.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E07 — Castle of Terror
The team goes to England to explore Chillingham, Britain's most haunted castle; thousands died in brutal battles on its grounds or by horrifying tortures in its dungeons; now, hostile spirits are said to roam the medieval building, seeking vengeance.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E08 — Rock of Nightmares
Exploring miles of abandoned tunnels inside the Rock of Gibraltar in pursuit of a ghostly local legend: the Mad Monk; digging deeper into its bloody history leads to a notoriously violent prison, where the walls are built from bones.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E07 — Texas Chupacabra
Heather and Phil sniff out the trail of a vampiric Chupacabra said to be terrorizing eastern Texas; joined by a new high-tech hound, can their robot companion help them catch this Badlands bloodsucker in the act?

title: Expedition X
description:

description:

Officers find farm equipment packed full of narcotics; teenagers are caught smuggling anti-anxiety pills; a truck is found with a secret compartment full of drugs, requiring a complex code to open it; a van's gas tank has more than fuel in it.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E01 — Put Your Shirt Back On
An expectant mother gets caught with an unexpected load in her car; officers stumble upon a shipment of narcotics not-so-secretly concealed; a bounty hunter has trouble keeping her cool when officers find she's carrying something illegal.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E04 — Pulp Addiction
Officers in Hidalgo are forced to close the bridge when it's stormed by asylum seekers attempting to jump ahead of hundreds of people waiting to seek refuge in the US; a cavity search reveals a pill smuggler concealing meds in an unpleasant place.

description:

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
